info.description:
REST API for users, projects, memberships, and tasks.
Authorization is enforced in the service layer; access
tokens are short-lived HS256 JWTs (typ=access), refresh
tokens are opaque and rotate with reuse detection.
info.title: Task Management API

post.description: Always returns the same generic acknowledgement whether or not the email is registered. When the account exists, a single-use reset code (15-minute default TTL) is emailed in the message body — never embedded in a URL — via a bounded, panic-recovered async workflow. The synchronous path does identical work for known and unknown emails (no timing oracle). Rate-limited per client IP.
Verifies credentials and issues an access token plus a refresh token with a fresh session. Unknown email and wrong password return the same 401.
Revokes the session of the presented refresh token. Idempotent for already-revoked tokens.
Revokes all active refresh sessions of the authenticated user.
Rotates the refresh token (row-locked, reuse-detecting). Reuse revokes the whole session and returns 401 with code token_reused.
Creates a user; only an argon2id hash of the password is stored.

Consumes the valid single-use reset code copied from the email body, stores a new argon2id hash, and revokes ALL refresh sessions atomically. Unknown, expired, and already-used codes return the same 401.

parameters.description: Emailed reset code and new password
parameters.name: body

401.description: unauthorized: invalid, expired, or reused token

post.description: Atomically creates the project and the creator's owner membership.

delete.description: Owner only. Memberships and tasks cascade.

patch.description: Owner/admin only. Omitted fields keep their values; description=null clears it.

post.description: Owner/admin only. The target user must exist; new members start with role member.

delete.description: Owner/admin, or non-owner self-leave. 409 while the member has assigned tasks; the owner must transfer ownership first (403).

patch.description: Owner/admin only. Role must be admin or member; the owner role changes exclusively via transfer-ownership.

403.description: forbidden (includes attempts to demote the owner)

get.description: Members only. Filters: status, priority, assigned_to, due_after, due_before (RFC3339). Sorting: sort_by=created_at|due_at|priority|status, sort_order=asc|desc. Pagination: limit (1-200, default 50), offset (>=0).

post.description: Any project member may create. Assignee, when set, must be a member of the same project. Defaults: status=todo, priority=medium.

404.description: not_found (also when the task belongs to another project)

delete.description: Write policy: task creator, current assignee, or project owner/admin.

patch.description: Write policy: task creator, current assignee, or project owner/admin. assigned_to=null unassigns; due_at=null clears the due date; omitted fields are unchanged. project_id and created_by are immutable.

post.description: Owner only. Transactional demote-before-promote under the project row lock; target must be an existing member; self-transfer is a no-op.

delete.description: Hard delete. Returns 409 while created projects/tasks or memberships exist (RESTRICT chain).

patch.description: Partial update of name/email. Email is normalized; duplicates return 409.

409.description: conflict: email in use or concurrently modified

patch.description: Verifies the current password, stores the new argon2id hash, and revokes ALL refresh sessions atomically.

get.description: Cross-project listing forced to the authenticated assignee. Same filtering/sorting/pagination as project task lists, plus optional project_id.

403.description: forbidden: not a member of project_id

token.description:
Token is the single-use reset code copied from the email body (S-05). It
is never carried in a URL, so it cannot leak via browser history/Referer.

description.description: String or null (null clears the description); omitted keeps it.

assigned_to.description: Assignee UUID string, or null to unassign; omitted keeps it.

description.description: String only; null is rejected (service cannot NULL the description).

due_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp string, or null to clear; omitted keeps it.
